R0.61–R0.69W advances from reduced recurrences to rigorous annular exclusion; R0.70A–R0.71Z examines moving scales, the critical ledger, internal entry, and the complete-root boundary; R0.72A–R0.73B treats strong coupling, the critical log, collision geometry, and the full linear Fourier--Leray row; R0.73C–I successively addresses frozen Rayleigh instability, viscous spectral-cluster persistence, transfer to a fixed positive half-plane, moving-profile gain, nonlinear relative amplification, fixed-distance planar departure, and the zero-window action boundary.
